 Television DC Correspondent 6 Nov 2026 12:51 PM IST 6 Nov 2026 12:51 PM IST Rumors are doing the rounds on social media that Rohit is likely to make a re-entry into the house during the weekend episode.
 x Rohit As Preferred
Source In last weekend's episode, Rohit was eliminated from the show. Ever since he left the house, Rohit's fans have been asking the show organisers to bring him back. His fans are hoping to see him back on the show.
 Rumors are doing the rounds on social media that Rohit is likely to make a re-entry into the house during the weekend episode. It is being said that he is being brought back into the show. Hold on, though. This has not been officially confirmed by the Bigg Boss Telugu makers yet. Before jumping to conclusions, let’s wait for an official confirmation from the makers.
 It would be unfair to other contestants if Rohit makes a re-entry into the house. He stepped out of the house and got to know what is happening on the outside, whereas the other contestants remain clueless about life outside the show.
 Let’s wait and see how the show unfolds in the coming days.
